admin.help.system: ⚙️ System and admins /maintenance on|off — maintenance mode (no new games) /flags — list feature flags, /flags <key> — toggle one /reloadlocales — re-read texts without a restart /health — uptime, games, timers /broadcast <text> — DM blast with confirmation /addadmin, /deladmin, /admins — owners from ADMIN_IDS only

help.text: 🎭 Mafia Bot — play mafia with friends Game (in a group): /newgame — open a lobby (aliases: /game, /mafia) /join — join the lobby (or use the button) /leave — leave the lobby /startgame — start the game (host only) /settings — lobby settings: roles and timers /extend — add +30s to the countdown /shorten — cut −30s from the countdown /cancel — cancel the lobby/game (host only) /alive — list of alive players /role — show my role again (in DM) Profile and progression: /me (/profile) — profile: rating, roles, streaks, achievements /stats — short statistics /top — leaderboards: this chat, season, wins, coins, winrate, streaks /lang — interface language (русский / English / o‘zbekcha) /help — this help Economy (in the bot DM): /shop — shop: cosmetics and role cards /balance — coin balance /inventory (/inv) — inventory and role-card activation /promo <code> — redeem a promo code Night commands (if the DM buttons did not arrive): /kill <name> — mafia/Don /check <name> — detective /heal <name> — doctor /block <name> — whore /search <name> — Don (look for the detective) /defend <name> — lawyer /maniac <name> — maniac Roles: 🟢 Citizen — votes during the day 🔴 Mafia — kills one townsfolk every night 🕴 Don — the deciding vote on the victim + hunts the detective ⚖️ Lawyer — plays for the mafia blindly: the client reads as “innocent” 🔵 Detective — checks one player each night 🎖 Sergeant — sees the detective's checks and inherits the role 🟡 Doctor — saves a player from death at night 💋 Whore — blocks a player's action at night 🔪 Maniac — third party: kills at night, wins alone Don, Lawyer, Sergeant, Whore and Maniac are optional roles enabled in the lobby “⚙️ Settings” menu. Players per lobby: {min}–{max} Town wins: eliminate all mafia and the maniac. Mafia wins: match the town in numbers (with the maniac gone). Maniac wins: be the last one standing. Admins: /admin — the panel, /adminhelp — the list of service commands.

role.citizen.description: You are an ordinary city resident. During the day you take part in the discussion and vote for whoever you suspect of being mafia. Your goal is to identify and eliminate the entire mafia.
role.citizen.title: 🟢 Citizen
role.detective.description: You are the detective. Every night you can check one player to learn whether they are mafia. Use the information carefully, without revealing yourself too early. Your goal is to help the city.
role.detective.title: 🔵 Detective
role.doctor.description: You are the doctor. Every night you choose a player to save. If the mafia attacks them — they will survive. You cannot heal the same player two nights in a row.
role.doctor.title: 🟡 Doctor
role.don.description: You are the Mafia Don, head of the crime family. You play for the mafia and pick the victim with them each night — your vote is decisive. The detective sees you as «not mafia»: you are disguised. Lead your crew to victory!
role.don.title: 🕴 Mafia Don
role.lawyer.description: You are mafia-aligned but do not know the family. Each night you pick a client: if the detective checks them, they read as a civilian.
role.lawyer.title: ⚖️ Lawyer
role.mafia.description: You are the mafia. Every night you choose a victim to kill. Your goal is to eliminate all peaceful residents and take over the city. During the day, pretend to be an ordinary citizen!
role.mafia.title: 🔴 Mafia
role.maniac.description: You play for yourself. Every night you kill one player. You win when you are the last one standing.
role.maniac.title: 🔪 Maniac
role.promoted_detective: 🎖 The detective is dead. You are the new detective — check players every night.
role.promoted_don: 🕴 The don is dead. You are the new Don of the mafia — your vote is now decisive.
role.sergeant.description: You are the detective's aide. You learn the results of every check, and if the detective dies you take their place.
role.sergeant.title: 🎖 Sergeant
role.whore.description: You are the Courtesan (Mistress). Each night you may visit one player and block them: their night action will not work this night. You cannot block yourself or the same player two nights in a row. You are on the city's side.
role.whore.title: 💋 Courtesan
role.your_role_footer: Don't reveal your role to anyone — or you'll lose!
